title: Run: M1 stability hardening
description: Increment M1 — the first deployable + demoable slice after the P0 backend incident: (1) JWT/HMAC signing key >= 32 bytes with startup validation, (2) bounded background fan-out (check_projects) so it cannot saturate CPU. Demo: restart API, warning gone, login works with a new token, and fan-out CPU before/after under the same load.
